Watts made this hymn from Psalm 25:12, 14, 10, 13, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

12Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him. 14The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them. 10All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees. 13His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land. PSALM 25:12, 14, 10, 13 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 25
Where shall the man be found That fears t' offend his God, That loves the gospel's joyful sound, And trembles at the rod? STANZA I
